opening.argument: The Bloomberg interview identifies its subject and speakers while examining the M&A market, tax reform, regulatory conditions, and activist investing as business topics. It discusses deal volume, corporate tax rates, and whether activism has performed well as an asset class, including the conditional view that M&A may become more active after tax reform. That is market analysis rather than a viewer-directed offer: the discussion does not require payment, request credentials, or describe a mechanism for obtaining returns. Its framing is consistent throughout, from the Bloomberg lower-third identifying “THE STATE OF THE M&A MARKET” to the explicit description of a Morgan Stanley M&A executive discussing industry conditions.

citations.quote: Robert Kindler, global head of M&A at Morgan Stanley, discusses the M&A market, activist investors, and the importance of tax reform to CEOs.
